rows.jyutping: hing1 fan5 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is ecstatic or extremely excited.

example.english: They were rapturous after receiving a big gift and could not sleep all night.
example.traditional: 佢收到份大禮，興奮到不得了，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sau1 dou2 fan6 daai6 lai5 hing1 fan5 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this especially for rapturous applause, cheers, support, or other intensely enthusiastic responses.

example.english: The audience gave the singer rapturous applause for the performance.
example.traditional: 觀眾對呢位歌手嘅演出報以熱烈掌聲。
example.jyutping: gun1 zung3 deoi3 ne1 wai6 go1 sau2 ge3 jin2 ceot1 bou3 ji5 jit6 lit6 zoeng2 sing1

rows.note: Use this formal idiom when describing someone as wildly joyful rather than merely excited.

example.english: They were rapturous when they learned they had won an award.
example.traditional: 佢得知自己獲獎之後，真係欣喜若狂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak1 zi1 zi6 gei2 wok6 zoeng2 zi1 hau6 zan1 hai6 jan1 hei2 joek6 kwong4
